description: The Bitcompare Stablecoin Yield Index: the median USDT or USDC lending rate across providers (one vote each), overall and split CeFi/DeFi, stored once per UTC day. A segment with too few providers (5 overall, 3 per split) is null with nullReason, never a thin number. reconstructed = rebuilt from stored history; provisional = the day is still being recomputed. CC BY 4.0: credit "Source: Bitcompare Stablecoin Yield Index". Returns the daily series for one coin and segment.

coin.description: Stablecoin: USDT or USDC. Default USDT.

from.description: Series start, YYYY-MM-DD (UTC). Default: 90 days before `to`.

segment.description: Provider segment: all (every provider), cefi or defi. Default all.

to.description: Series end, YYYY-MM-DD (UTC). Default: today. At most 731 days per request.

name: stablecoin_yield_index

minProviders.description: Votes needed before the segment prints

provisional.description: Still being recomputed; final days never change

reconstructed.description: Rebuilt from stored history after the fact

value.description: Segment median rate (%), or null below the provider minimum

title: Bitcompare Stablecoin Yield Index (daily series)
